attr.title: Gone Fishing
attr.desc: A quiet pixel-art fishing game. Row or motor across five places, from an autumn lake to the Columbia River under Mt. Hood, watch the fish under your boat and put your lure where they swim. 42 fish with their own fights, five legends, ten lures, trolling, day and night, weather, goals, gear upgrades, a customizable angler and a dog or cat for company.
